newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Altron sees real 1997/98 group growth.
newsitem.headline: Altron sees real 1997/98 group growth.

text.p: Allied Electronics Corp Ltd (Altron) said on Wednesday it was confident of real growth for the group in the forthcoming year.

Releasing results for the year ended February 28, 1997 it said in a statement that the group is expected to benefit from the business flowing from parastatal Eskom's electrification programme and telecommunications utility Telkom's Vision 2000 programmes.
"Given the reasonable economic and social conditions, the board is confident that the forthcoming year will be a year of real growth for the group," Altron said.
It said its order book levels were high and at satisfactory margins.
The firm added that black equity partners for a number of its companies had been identified and negotiations were in progress. It gave no further details.
Altron reported a 15 percent increase in headline earnings to 63.8 cents a share for the year. It posted a 23.0 cents dividend -- up 16 percent on a year ago.
